questions.text: a. Outline and briefly explain the basic structure of a research report or write-up. [10%]

b. Study the following narrative on a research/project and deduce the research gap, problem definition, goal, research methodology and outcome. [6%]

The project aimed to address the challenges of resource sharing and data management across multiple departments and campuses within the university. The project involved the design and implementation of a robust network infrastructure, the integration of various computing systems and technologies, and the development of a distributed file system for seamless data sharing and management. The project team also ensured the security and privacy of data by implementing access control mechanisms, data encryption, and secure communication protocols. The project resulted in improved collaboration, resource utilization, and data management across various departments and campuses within the university. The case study highlights the challenges encountered during the implementation process and the lessons learned, including the importance of stakeholder engagement, effective project management, and technical expertise. The successful implementation of this university-wide distributed system has provided a scalable and reliable solution to address the university's resource sharing and data management needs, positioning it for future growth and development.
(Source: Group 15 Semester Project, 2023 p. 3)
